rationale: App 8.8.0 was released November 4 and its tested row explicitly includes optional ES 8.8.0 and 8.7.0, Enterprise 10.4.2/10.2.2 and Cloud Platform 10.5.2605/10.4.2604. The Cloud SOAR column names 8.8.0 and 8.7.0. The on-premises column names 8.8.0 plus an unreadable second version printed 8..0. App 8.7.0 retains ES 8.7.0/8.6.1.
